author: China Insights
description:
When “Let the Leaders Go First” becomes real, who gets pushed to the front line as a human shield? The Party suddenly hides away. The Chinese military newspaper’s comment focuses only on “the People”! A Chinese student in Iran asks the Chinese embassy for help: They push it away, say no, and block him – all in one go!

China Insights delivers sharp, data-driven analysis of China’s politics, economy, and society.
We connect the dots behind breaking headlines — from Beijing’s power shifts to global market trends — helping viewers understand the real forces shaping modern China.
Stay informed. Stay ahead.
title: When “Let the Leaders Go First” becomes real, who gets pushed to the front line as a human shield?
